To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) Scop3D can be used for the analysis of sequence variants in relation to the structure of the protein; (2) Scop3d is now available as a user-friendly web-interface; (3) Scop3Ds DNA module allows the analysis of SNPs in relation to protein structure.

we have developed a new version of the Scop3D tool that allows for online visualization of mutation rates on protein structures, that we have added a DNA module to allow for the analysis of single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) and that we have made the tool available through an intuitive, user-friendly, web-interface.
Scop3D has been upgraded and rewritten and that it is now available through an intuitive and user-friendly web-interface.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a tool that can be used to visualize and analyze the effects of sequence variants on the structure of proteins.
the development and application of computational methods for the analysis of protein structure and evolution, with a focus on the integration of protein sequence and structure data.
the integration of sequence conservation data with protein structure and the visualization of this information on the protein structure.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Scop3D has been improved to a level that it is a very valuable tool to analyze protein structure in the context of sequence variation and conservation.
Scop3D has become a very useful tool for the structural biologist, the molecular biologist, the geneticist and the medical doctor.
Scop3D has become an even better tool than before, with the additional benefit of being available through a web interface.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Scop3D now provides a complete online tool that is able to visualize mutation rates on a protein structure in an interactive way.
we have upgraded and rewritten the original Scop3D tool to make it more robust and to include new features.
Scop3D now provides the user with a powerful tool that can be used to study the effect of mutations on protein structure.

we can now easily analyze and visualize the effect of mutations on the protein structure and its functional sites.
the combination of protein structure and sequence variation information provides an excellent framework for understanding the impact of mutations in proteins.
